name: Alsmic Lizzi
original_name: アルスミック・リズィ
source:
Is there such a thing as "love"?

—I want to shatter the bond we called "sisterhood".

The catalyst for this desire was a play I saw back in middle school, performed by the drama club.
The lead actress, Anri Shu, captivated the audience with her beauty and acting.
Since then, my feelings kept growing inside me, until I finally realized it was "love".
But the closer we were, the harder it became to confess.
I was too afraid of losing the unique bond we shared as "sisters"...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11706]Novelgame[/url]]
